t: A tiny Linux board with camera inputs, Ethernet and a small AI chip.
steps: Buy the Duo S from the Milk-V store or ARACE. The base board starts near 10 US dollars.
Get a microSD card, a USB-C cable and a network cable.
Download the official Duo S image from the Milk-V docs.
Write the image to the card with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Set the boot switch to match the image you chose.
Power the board and log in over SSH from your computer.
Try the blink example from the Milk-V docs next.
meta: Open Board. From $9.90. A few stores.
